name: Promotion Ladder Policy v2
description: Lifecycle stages for hypotheses and models
rules: Minimum requirements for PAPER_ELIGIBLE include: successful confirmatory test, predefined statistical support, predefined economic materiality, completed required universe tests, temporal validation, reproducibility, PIT/data integrity, portfolio economics where relevant
High IC alone does not justify promotion

promotion_requirements.PROPOSED_to_EXPLORATORY: Hypothesis with mechanism, prediction, falsification criteria
